t: Should You Buy A New Or Used Car? | Bankrate
s: December 19, 2025 - Deciding between that new-car smell and a pre-owned vehicle involves more than just price, but it’s an important factor. A used car is a good choice if you’re trying to save on your initial purchase. But you’ll need to consider the cost over the life of ownership — including maintenance and repairs. Depending on how you want to use the vehicle and your overall finances, you may find that buying new is the better choice.
